newsitem.title: USA: Alliance Pharm therapy safe in early trial.
newsitem.headline: Alliance Pharm therapy safe in early trial.

text.p: Alliance Pharmaceutical Corp said Monday a therapy it is co-developing to treat acute hypoxemic respiratory failure was shown to be safe in an early clinical trial and improved survival in patients 55 years of age and younger.
The LiquiVent therapy, used in the partial liquid ventilation technique, is being co-developed with Hoechst Marion Roussel, a unit of Hoechst AG.

In the pilot Phase II clinical trial, the Liquivent procedure compared to conventional mechanical ventilation reduced significantly the number of days on mechanical ventilation support in 58 patients who were 55 years of age or younger, Alliance said.
There were 90 adult patients enrolled in the trial. Sixty-five received LiquiVent in the partial liquid ventilation technique, and 25 were treated by conventional mechanical ventilation, it said.

An imbalance between study groups in the number of patients greater than age 55 resulted in insufficient control patients (2) versus LiquiVent-treated patients (18) to allow assessment of the effect of the drug in the older sub-population, it said.
Alliance said results of the study were shared with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, and preparations are under way for a larger, pivotal adult Phase II/III study.
